descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles.
 What you’ll find here:
 Digital transformation projects with real impact
 A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
 Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
 Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for experienced professionals to deliver high-quality, stable, and resilient software solutions.
 🔍 RESPONSIBILITIES 
Take part in discovery and analysis sessions to understand objectives and non-functional requirements
Assess performance risks related to new features or architectural changes
Define performance testing strategies based on business and technical requirements
Create performance test plans covering scope, objectives, workload models, success criteria, and execution approach
Develop reusable and maintainable performance test scripts
Model realistic workloads based on expected application usage
Implement parameterization, correlation, dynamic data handling, and reusable script components
Test web, mobile, API, and microservice applications
Plan and execute load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity tests
Monitor test execution and validate the integrity of results
Analyze response times, throughput, transaction success rates, errors, resource utilization, scalability, and system stability
Identify performance bottlenecks and correlate application behavior with infrastructure metrics
Investigate root causes and recommend improvements to application performance, scalability, and stability
Prepare technical and executive reports, documenting risks, bottlenecks, trends, and opportunities for improvement
Present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Support development teams with performance optimization activities
Contribute to integrating performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and improving testing practices
 🛠️REQUIREMENTS 
Knowledge of performance testing methodologies and engineering principles
Knowledge of French
Understanding of workload modelling, test planning, bottleneck identification, scalability, capacity planning, and performance analysis
Experience with one or more performance testing tools, such as:
- OpenText LoadRunner Enterprise
- OpenText VuGen
- OpenText Analysis
Knowledge of HTTP, HTTPS, REST APIs, and SOAP
Familiarity with web applications, APIs, distributed systems, and microservices
Knowledge of at least one scripting or programming language, such as JavaScript, Java, Python, or Groovy
Basic scripting skills for automation, data manipulation, and script development or customization
Ability to design and execute performance test campaigns independently
Ability to create complex scripts and workload models, develop reusable components, and perform root cause analysis
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, curiosity, and accountability
Good communication, teamwork, time management, and organizational skills
Ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders
Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English
 Nice to have 
Experience with Apache JMeter, Gatling, k6, NeoLoad, or BlazeMeter
Knowledge of GraphQL or WebSockets
Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Icinga, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or ELK Stack
Ability to interpret application and infrastructure metrics
Understanding of JVM and garbage collection processes
Basic knowledge of Git, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions
Experience integrating performance testing into delivery pipelines
Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, infrastructure monitoring, networking, or test automation frameworks
Knowledge of cloud scaling practices such as HPA and VPA
Experience with AI-assisted testing tools
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification, or another relevant performance testing, application, or cloud certification
 📍 Location & Setup 
 Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
